verdict.rationale: Mastra's docs describe built-in scorers that measure agent quality using model-graded, rule-based, and statistical methods, plus live evaluations that score outputs in real time. So the scoring half of the story is clearly delivered. Nothing in the pack shows running these evals in CI. Missing for 10: documented CI integration or test-runner usage for scorers, independent or hands-on corroboration of the evals feature.
